item.title: Google Urges Chrome Users to Update Immediately After Patching First Zero-Day Exploit of 2026
item.description: Google has released an urgent security update for its Chrome browser to address a high-severity zero-day vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, marking the first such flaw patched in 2026.

item.title: 10 Key Facts About Sarah Ferguson Amid Latest Business Closures and Epstein Revelations
item.description: Sarah Ferguson, the 66-year-old former Duchess of York commonly known as Fergie, remains a polarizing figure in British public life.

item.title: (VIDEO) Samsung's Galaxy S26 Series to Empower Users as Content Creators with Advanced Galaxy AI Tools
item.description: Samsung Electronics is set to unveil its next flagship smartphone lineup, the Galaxy S26 series, at Galaxy Unpacked on February 25, 2026, in San Francisco. The company has ramped up teasers emphasizing how Galaxy AI enhancements will transform ordinary smartphone users into effortless content creators through a unified, intuitive camera and editing experience.

item.title: (VIDEO) Punch the Monkey: Orphaned Baby Macaque Punch-kun Goes Viral at Japanese Zoo
item.description: A six-month-old Japanese macaque named Punch-kun has captured hearts worldwide after videos and photos of him carrying a large stuffed orangutan toy everywhere went viral on social media.

item.title: (VIDEO) Chicago Bears Closer to Northwest Indiana Move as Indiana Committee Approves Stadium Funding Bill
item.description: The Chicago Bears moved one significant step closer to potentially relocating across state lines after an Indiana House committee unanimously approved legislation Thursday that establishes the framework for financing and building a new stadium in Northwest Indiana.

item.title: Eric Dane Has Passed Away at 53 Following a Courageous Battle With ALS
item.description: Grey's Anatomy star Eric Dane has passed away just 10 months after announcing his ALS diagnosis. He was 53 years old.

item.title: Donald Trump Calls Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's Arrest 'So Bad for the Royal Family'
item.description: US President Trump calls Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's arrest, which took place Thursday, a "shame" and "very sad."

item.title: Bill Gates Cancels AI Impact Summit Appearance Amid Jeffrey Epstein Scrutiny
item.description: Microsoft co-founder Bill gate has cancelled his keynote address at AI Impact Summit in India amid the scrutiny over his ties with Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: 10 Essential Facts About Eric Dane: 'Grey's Anatomy' Star Dies at 53 After ALS Battle
item.description: Eric Dane, the charismatic actor beloved for his role as plastic surgeon Dr. Mark "McSteamy" Sloan on Grey's Anatomy and his intense portrayal of Cal Jacobs on Euphoria, died Thursday, Feb. 19, at age 53 after a courageous battle with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

item.title: NSW Announces Plans to Introduce Minimum Age Requirement for E-Bike Riders
item.description: The New South Wales government is planning to ban those under the age of 12 from riding e-bikes by the end of 2026.
